rows.information: Centre for Excellence in CSR & Corporate Citizenship

content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs, Manesar, is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. It provides knowledge and professional training through five Schools and eleven Centres, and its specialised areas include Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). The campus covers 14 acres in IMT Manesar, District Gurugram, Haryana.

content_sections.heading: IICA Research Associate Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The table on page 1 of the circular prints the pay of the IICA position as "Rs. 4,0000/-", while Annexure-I gives it as Rs. 40,000/-. Pay is a consolidated monthly amount. No Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, medical facilities or other compensation packages are admissible. Increments and leave follow the policy of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IICA Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Citizenship: The applicant must be an Indian citizen. The same requirements are printed for both positions. A Postgraduate degree in a relevant field such as Social sciences, Social Work etc. with exposure on CSR, sustainability or related fields. Proficiency with MS Office, particularly MS Word and MS Excel. Excel is a must for data analysis. Good communication and writing skills, including written and verbal skills to contribute to research reports and presentations. Strong attention to detail, an analytical mindset and the ability to draw insights from data. Enthusiasm for CSR and sustainability topics. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Travel to field areas across India for data collection, meetings and business development is a must. 1-3 years' experience (internships, research assistantships or related roles) in conducting research or data analysis is a plus. Experience of handling files, the eProcurement system within the government system and tenders of the development sector is preferred. Experience of preparing presentations on infographics software is desirable. Proficiency in SPSS, R or similar tools is desirable. The circular treats the last date for applications as the crucial date for eligibility, qualifications, experience and age. Having the minimum qualification does not by itself entitle a candidate to a presentation or interview, and provisional claims about eligibility will not be accepted. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Research Associate
content_sections.text: Both positions carry the same responsibilities: Assist senior researchers in planning and conducting research projects, literature reviews and data collection. Gather data from surveys, interviews, databases and secondary research. Analyse quantitative and qualitative data under the supervision of senior researchers. Contribute well-organised data and insights to research reports, articles and presentations. Identify key research gaps and relevant studies in CSR and sustainability. Support research administration, including record-keeping, documentation, datasheets and updated content modules. Handle office files and coordinate with Finance, Administration, IT and other schools and centres of IICA. Manage finances, including follow-up on invoices and settlement of advances for ongoing and upcoming projects. Handle or coordinate the Learning Management System and the logistics of the Centre. Take part in training sessions to build research and secretarial skills.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications received by the due date are screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience criteria. The duly constituted Selection Committee shortlists candidates. The Institute reserves the right to devise its own shortlisting criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview before the Selection Committee, at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference. The date and time of the presentation and/or interview will be communicated separately, and IICA will communicate only with shortlisted candidates. Final results will be published on its website after the recruitment process ends. IICA's decision on eligibility, rejection of applications, equivalence of qualifications and the mode of selection is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for one year and may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the competent authority, depending on performance and requirement. For the WNS Project position, the engagement may be extended based on performance and project requirements up to the duration of the project, as it is co-terminus with the project. The assignment is full time, and the person must attend office on all working days and on holidays, if required. Either side can terminate the contract by giving two months' notice or two months' consolidated emoluments in lieu. The person cannot apply for any position within or outside IICA while the contract is valid or before 2 years of joining, whichever is later. To apply internally, the present contract must be terminated. Selected candidates must sign a contract with IICA and join immediately. Candidates must be of sound health and may have to undergo a medical examination if selected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IICA Research Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Confirm that you meet the age, qualification and experience criteria for the position. Candidature will be cancelled if you do not, or if you give false information or suppress a material fact. Open the application link for your position from the table under Important Links. Enter all your qualifications and relevant experience above the minimum prescribed, and make sure every detail is complete and correct. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Submit the application so that it reaches IICA by the last date. Late applications will be summarily rejected, and IICA is not responsible for non-receipt or delay. Documents to attach (self-attested copies): Matriculation or equivalent certificate as proof of age. Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation, Higher Secondary or equivalent certificate is accepted. Degree, Diploma or other certificates, including mark-sheets. Mark-sheets alone will not be accepted in place of the certificates. If your qualification is an equivalent one, the authority (with number and date) under which it is treated as equivalent. Certificates from the Head of each organisation or department for all experience claimed, on letterhead and duly stamped by the Competent Authority. They must show the duration of employment (date, month and year), the basic and consolidated pay, and the nature of duties performed. Any inconsistency between documents must be explained. Documents with corrections, alterations or tampering must not be submitted. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

faq.question: Q1. Which form should I use for each Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The circular lists a separate Google Form for each serial number. In its table of posts, Sl. No. 1 is the IICA position and Sl. No. 2 is the WNS Project position.

faq.question: Q2. Is research experience compulsory for these posts?
faq.answer: The circular describes 1-3 years' experience in research or data analysis, including internships and research assistantships, as "a plus".

faq.question: Q3. Is travel part of the job?
faq.answer: Yes. Travel to field areas across India for data collection, meetings and business development is listed as a must.

faq.question: Q4. Which software should I know?
faq.answer: Excel is a must, and proficiency with MS Word is also expected. SPSS, R or similar tools are desirable, as is experience with infographics software for presentations.

faq.question: Q5. Will I get HRA or medical benefits along with the pay?
faq.answer: No. The consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- or Rs. 60,000/- is the full monthly payment, and HRA and medical facilities are specifically excluded.

faq.question: Q6. Will IICA pay my travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The circular states that no TA/DA shall be permissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Should I send original certificates with the application?
faq.answer: No. Originals should be produced at the presentation and/or interview. An application received without the copies of the required certificates will be rejected, with no appeal against the rejection.

faq.question: Q8. Can I contact IICA about my application status?
faq.answer: No interim correspondence or personal enquiries will be entertained. IICA will also not correspond with candidates about the reasons for non-selection.

faq.question: Q9. Which courts handle disputes about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts in Haryana.
